# Replay gate fixtures

These status files are synthetic inputs for structural replay and CI threshold tests. Their
source hashes, source block IDs, and evidence IDs are deterministic fixture identities; they
do not identify a real government PDF and do not demonstrate source authenticity. The
`fail_low_evidence` corpus intentionally keeps weak evidence to exercise the failing gate.

Business accuracy, OCR quality, and real-source evidence authentication must be evaluated
with separately frozen source PDFs and reviewed annotations.
